pairs: Factum est autem cum Apollo esset Corinthi,
Now it happened that, while Apollo was at Corinth,
ut Paulus peragratis superioribus partibus veniret Ephesum,
Paul, after he had journeyed through the upper regions, arrived at Ephesus.
And he met with certain disciples.
have you received the Holy Spirit?”
Sed neque si Spiritus Sanctus est,
“We have not even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.”
“Then with what have you been baptized?”
“John baptized the people with the baptism of repentance,
dicens in eum qui venturus esset post ipsum ut crederent,
saying that they should believe in the One who is to come after him,
baptizati sunt in nomine Domini Jesu.
they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.
Et cum imposuisset illis manus Paulus,
And when Paul had imposed his hands on them,
the Holy Spirit came over them.
And they were speaking in tongues
Erant autem omnes viri fere duodecim.
Now the men were about twelve in all.
cum fiducia loquebatur per tres menses,
he was speaking faithfully for three months,
disputing and persuading them about the kingdom of God.
But when certain ones became hardened and would not believe,
cursing the Way of the Lord in the presence of the multitude,
quotidie disputans in schola tyranni cujusdam.
disputing daily in a certain school of Tyrannus.
Hoc autem factum est per biennium,
Now this was done throughout two years,
ita ut omnes qui habitabant in Asia audirent verbum Domini,
so that all who were living in Asia listened to the Word of the Lord,
Virtutesque non quaslibet faciebat Deus per manum Pauli,
And God was accomplishing powerful and uncommon miracles by the hand of Paul,
ita ut etiam super languidos deferrentur a corpore ejus sudaria et semicinctia,
so much so that even when small cloths and wrappings were brought from his body to the sick,
et recedebant ab eis languores, et spiritus nequam egrediebantur.
the illnesses withdrew from them and the wicked spirits departed.
et de circumeuntibus Judæis exorcistis invocare super eos qui habebant spiritus malos nomen Domini Jesu,
even some of the traveling Jewish exorcists had attempted to invoke the name of the Lord Jesus over those who had evil spirits,
“I bind you by oath through Jesus,
the seven sons of Sceva, leaders among the priests,
who were acting in this way.
Respondens autem spiritus nequam dixit eis:
But a wicked spirit responded by saying to them:
in whom there was a wicked spirit,
leaping at them and getting the better of them both,
so that they fled from that house,
et vulnerati effugerent de domo illa.
Hoc autem notum factum est omnibus Judæis,
this became known to all the Jews and Gentiles who were living at Ephesus.
et cecidit timor super omnes illos,
And a fear fell over them all.
And the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.
Multi autem ex eis, qui fuerant curiosa sectati, contulerunt libros,
Then many of those who had followed odd sects brought together their books,
and they burned them in the sight of all.
And after determining the value of these,
they found the price to be fifty thousand denarii.
the Word of God was increasing strongly and was being confirmed.

it is necessary for me to see Rome also.”
Mittens autem in Macedoniam duos ex ministrantibus sibi,
But sending two of those who were ministering to him,
ipse remansit ad tempus in Asia.
he himself remained for a time in Asia.
Facta est autem illo tempore turbatio non minima de via Domini.
Now at that time, there occurred no small disturbance concerning the Way of the Lord.
For a certain man named Demetrius,
a silversmith making silver shrines for Diana,
was providing no small profit to craftsmen.
et eos qui hujusmodi erant opifices,
with those who were employed in the same way,
scitis quia de hoc artificio est nobis acquisitio:
you know that our income is from this craft.
And you are seeing and hearing that this man Paul,
et auditis quia non solum Ephesi,
has turned away a great multitude,
Paulus hic suadens avertit multam turbam,
but from nearly all of Asia,
‘These things are not gods which have been made by hands.’
Non solum autem hæc periclitabitur nobis pars in redargutionem venire, sed et magnæ Dianæ templum in nihilum reputabitur, sed et destrui incipiet majestas ejus, quam tota Asia et orbis colit.

Thus, not only is this, our occupation, in danger of being brought into repudiation, but also the temple of the great Diana will be reputed as nothing! Then even her majesty, whom all of Asia and the world worships, will begin to be destroyed.”
And the city was filled with confusion.
et impetum fecerunt uno animo in theatrum,
And having seized Gaius and Aristarchus of Macedonia,
companions of Paul, they rushed violently, with one accord,
Paulo autem volente intrare in populum,
Then, when Paul wanted to enter to the people,
the disciples would not permit him.
And some of the leaders from Asia,
miserunt ad eum rogantes ne se daret in theatrum:
requesting that he not present himself in the amphitheater.
But others were crying out various things.
For the assembly was in confusion,
et plures nesciebant qua ex causa convenissent.
and most did not know the reason they had been called together.
De turba autem detraxerunt Alexandrum, propellentibus eum Judæis.
So they dragged Alexander from the crowd, while the Jews were propelling him forward.
And Alexander, gesturing with his hand for silence,
wanted to give the people an explanation.
Quem ut cognoverunt Judæum esse, vox facta una est omnium,
But as soon as they realized him to be a Jew, all with one voice,
for about two hours, were crying out,
And when the scribe had calmed the crowds,
quis enim est hominum, qui nesciat Ephesiorum civitatem cultricem esse magnæ Dianæ, Jovisque prolis?
now what man is there who does not know that the city of the Ephesians is in the service of the great Diana and of the offspring of Jupiter?
Cum ergo his contradici non possit,
since these things are not able to be contradicted,
it is necessary for you to be calm and to do nothing rash.
For you have brought forward these men,
Quod si Demetrius et qui cum eo sunt artifices,
and the craftsmen who are with him have a case against anyone,
they can convene in the courts,
Si quid autem alterius rei quæritis,
But if you would inquire about other things,
this can be decided in a lawful assembly.
Nam et periclitamur argui seditionis hodiernæ,
For now we are in peril of being convicted of sedition over today’s events,
cum nullus obnoxius sit de quo possimus reddere rationem concursus istius.
since there is no one guilty (against whom we are able to provide evidence) in this gathering.”
